item.title: schema migrations, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
Every few months schema migrations bites me again. This is what finally stuck.

why it matters

Schema migrations shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.
  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: a short note about schema migrations
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
I spent a while getting schema migrations wrong. Here is the version that works for me.

why it matters

Schema migrations shows up across backend work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Measure before you change anything; intuition is a poor profiler.
  • Make the default path the correct path so nobody has to remember the rule.
  • If it is hard to test, that is the design telling you something.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
